crossRefs.note: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will…
and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.
Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find…
This is Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought.
Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the…
“Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held…
Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; For these pine away, stricken…
Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
Who is wise enough to understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of Yahweh has spoken, that he may declare it? Why…
The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
translations.bsb: There was no food, however, in all that region, because the famine was so severe; the lands of Egypt and Canaan had been exhausted by the famine.
translations.kjv: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
translations.asv: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
